request.text: One car-to-car side collision. Sharp steel contact, short buckling grind, debris settling. No engine bed or tyre squeal. Timbre: a dense chassis crush and wrenching heavy steel. Close foundry steel, blunt low-mid weight, analog grit, short concrete reflection. 1.5 seconds. Original isolated effect; no music, no voice.
